c74object.name: lp.abbie
c74object.digest: Generate beta and arc sine random numbers
c74object.description: lp.abbie generates random numbers between 0 and 1 from a beta distribution. a pulls values towards 0, b towards 1; a = b = 0.5 (the default) gives the arc sine distribution.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: float
method.description: In the 2nd inlet: a: tendency towards 0. In the 3rd inlet: b: tendency towards 1.

method.name: seed
method.digest: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically)
method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).

method.description: Send an attribute value to a receive object: tell <receive name> <attribute>.
